decision: Use exactly pinned Zod 4.6.7 with the existing controlled React fields and one shared typed useTunnerForm adapter; avoid a second form-state dependency.

primary_sources.finding: Typed schemas, safeParse and structured issues support field and form errors.
Current 4.6.7 release and prior 4.6.6 release security explanation reviewed; upstream states reverted malicious repository changes did not reach published npm releases.
RHF/Zod integration considered; existing controlled components already own state, and the small shared adapter satisfies current contract without another form library.
Exact package metadata and MIT license checked; npm provenance metadata available.

verification.advisory_audit: PASS: zero known advisories at check time

limits: Metadata and lockfile integrity verified; no claim of manual cryptographic npm attestation validation. Advisory status is time-bounded. Domain schemas and authoritative backend validation remain separate.
